Did it flip? 📈 0 of last week's 5 drops made money on eBay after fees

Our calls before release: 2 of 4 right ✅

1. Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro "Mamba Eterno": $190 retail → $264 eBay (+$23) · Wash (we said Cop)
2. Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro "Black": $190 retail → $238 eBay (−$1) · Wash (we said Cop)
3. Air Jordan 6 "White Infrared": $215 retail → $213 eBay (−$51) · Bricked (we said Cop to wear)
4. New Balance Niobium C1 Tokyo Design Studio "Black Magnet": $300 retail → $291 eBay (−$71) · Bricked
5. Air Jordan 3 "Fireside": $205 retail → $168 eBay (−$82) · Bricked (we said Wait)

eBay = median sold price (5+ sales) or the low end of new pairs listed. Profit after ~8% tax, eBay fees and shipping. Prices vary by size and change fast.
